Dream 2026-11-22 linked 15 vignettes from 7 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-22 · touches · "Focus s a closed boundary , focussing on our will. Opening up, zooming out is sensing" (Focus is a closed boundary; zooming out is sensing (2026-10-22))
- 2026-10-24 · retells · "Getting things done vs developing how we get things done." (Evolving the axes: localised versions of the classic (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-24 · retells · "The next cycle has a lean towards action." (The editor group's stance for the next cycle: Thunder (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "These are the three trigram lines. They are used all over our work. And should be foundational." (The three trigram lines are foundational; line 2 is disrupt or stabilise (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Line 3 sets the scale of the boundary." (Every decision is an experiment: good enough for now, why, and what would make us reconsider (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Line 2: Disrupt/ stabilise Bring in new things/ make what we have better" (The axes got lost; the base axis structure (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-28 · retells · "Every domain must have energy in a direction." (Evolve shared understanding gradually; the three lines are a universal lens every domain carries (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · retells · "The compass is made up of a 3x4 matrix... the 3 in the compass are individual/relational/systemic" (Do not mix synthetic logic lenses: the compass rows are individual/relational/systemic; the three axes are its diagonals (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "The fractal version is the current attempt to get domain and working group axes" (The SRS compass is advanced and all spec decisions go through it; should every project have its equivalent? (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "we build a consistent system by being consistent" (Base trigram axes and poles apply by default; every decision gets a trigram, and consistency builds the system (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "The zodiac is canon. The 4 elements are cannon." (The zodiac and the four elements are canon; the zodiac is built two ways, and only elements by levels unfolds in sign order (2026-10-28))
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "the trigram based 3 axis polarity notes. We can classify on the axes pretty reliably." (Kinds of problem are still being learned; the three-axis stance may relate to kinds (2026-11-03))
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "a lot of my original background work into these axes and archetypes" (greenmans_creation holds the original background work on the axes and archetypes; the semantic GIS SQL is also potentially interesting (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "The ability to recognise the T3 axes is part of a our bigger work into working with semantics at scale." (Recognising the T3 axes is part of the bigger work on semantics at scale; the-system-networks applies them to mapping networks (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "they are universal and the three axes can always be found" (My thesis: the base lines are universal and the three axes can always be found (2026-11-06))
